name: Baserow
description: Baserow is an open-source no-code database and spreadsheet platform built by Baserow B.V. in Amsterdam. It provides a collaborative, Airtable-like interface for structured data with a REST API, self-hosting capability, and a plugin system for custom fields, views, and application logic.

owner.name: Baserow B.V.
owner.description: Dutch company developing the Baserow open-source no-code database platform, based in Amsterdam.
